headline: Indian markets head for flat start amid geopolitical tensions and falling crude oil prices

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: GIFT Nifty signals a muted and flat start for Sensex and Nifty 50.
Crude oil prices drop below $102 for a fourth straight day as investors assess Saudi export recovery.
Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and US tariff risks weigh on broader market sentiment.
Positive US-China talks provide underlying support to broader Asian equities.
whatHappening: Nifty hovers near the 23,000 level as analysts forecast uncertain market trends ahead.
Three new SME IPOs open for subscription today across price bands and lot sizes.
Twelve midcap stocks achieve a positive technical breakout by crossing above their 200-day moving averages.
Gold prices ease amid ongoing inflation worries and interest rate hike fears.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices are expected to open flat today as GIFT Nifty indicates a muted start.
While Asian markets gained on positive US-China talks, crude oil declines and Middle East tensions continue to create uncertainty.
Key individual stocks including Mazagon Dock, RVNL, Nestle India, and Paytm are expected to remain in focus.
